description: This file defines the core streaming interfaces and implementations for gRPC in Go, including client and server stream handling, stream creation, retry logic, message preparation, and associated utilities.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Deprecated interface for common stream behavior, replaced by ClientStream and ServerStream.

classes.name: ClientStream
classes.description: Interface defining client-side streaming RPC behavior.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Interface defining common stream behavior, deprecated.

classes.name: clientStream
classes.description: Implementation of a client-side stream, managing retries, message sending/receiving, and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: csAttempt
classes.description: Represents a single attempt at a client stream, handling transport and stream creation, message exchange, and retries.

classes.name: serverStream
classes.description: Implementation of server-side stream handling, including message sending/receiving and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: addrConnStream
classes.description: Stream implementation for non-retry, non-tracing client streams over a specific transport.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Retrieves the header metadata from the stream.

methods.name: Trailer
methods.description: Retrieves the trailer metadata from the stream.

methods.name: SendMsg
methods.description: Sends a message over the stream.

methods.name: RecvMsg
methods.description: Receives a message from the stream.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Performs cleanup and finalization of the stream, including logging and stats.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Selects and establishes a transport for the stream attempt.

methods.name: newStream
methods.description: Creates a new transport stream for the attempt.

methods.name: Context
methods.description: Returns the context associated with the stream.

methods.name: withRetry
methods.description: Executes an operation with retry logic, handling attempt creation and retries.

methods.name: retryLocked
methods.description: Handles retry logic for a client stream upon errors.
